name: BACH_0370
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (94%)** · Confident · Read in turn
- Tier-4 case with singleton conformal set [F1], though 4/5 nearest neighbors are InSitu.

## Confidence
|Signal | Value | Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities | Benign 94%, InSitu 6%, Invasive 0%, Normal 0% | Benign strongly favored over InSitu|
|Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% coverage | Single class meets dataset guarantee|
|Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th-percentile OOD [F6] | Passes QC; extreme OOD percentile|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur|
|Similar cases | 1/5 Benign (20%); 4/5 InSitu [F5] | Nearest neighbors favor InSitu|

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score (-1.01) pushes against invasion [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.89); unreliable 0/20 spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.62) pushes toward invasion [F4] · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 2, 4, 6) · context · 84% tumor fraction (99th percentile) [F7]; 0th-percentile 43 µm² size [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 region removal beats random removal (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Four of five nearest neighbors are InSitu (BACH_0189, 84% similarity), and region 4 has 98% risk.
- Regions 2, 4, 6 with 99th-percentile tumor density (4438/mm²) [F8] and 93rd-percentile size variation [F10] are carcinoma.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 6**: Inspect highest-risk regions (98%, 76%, 45% risk) for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 10**: Verify if duct-confined cells are benign or InSitu (12/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 2, 4, 6**: Check if 183–228 segmented neoplastic nuclei are false positives.
